title: Returns Desk Policy: Sealed Blood Glucose Testing Supplies
content:
Larkfield accepts a return of Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program items only when they are unopened and in their original sealed packaging. Opened medical supplies are never returned to stock or credited on any tier where opened supplies are not returnable, because a supply that has left Larkfield's control cannot be re-dispensed to another patient. A strip vial or lancet box whose seal is broken is opened, and a meter that has been powered on is opened; neither is returnable. That the items are unopened is taken from the customer's statement when the return is authorized.

**Return window.** A return is authorized only when the customer asks for it no later than the tier's return window, in calendar days after the delivery date on the proof of delivery for that shipment, counted in calendar days from that delivery date with the last day allowed. A shipment without a proof of delivery cannot be returned, and a package damaged in transit is handled as a replacement, not a return.

**Units.** The units authorized for return never exceed the units of that shipment, less any units of it already authorized for return.

**Receipt and credit.** When the warehouse accepts the returned units as unopened and sealed, the units are credited back to the authorization they were drawn from. A payer-billed shipment is then re-billed by a void claim when all units were returned, or by a corrected claim when some units were returned. A self-pay shipment is credited to the customer's balance at the price paid for the returned units less the tier's restocking fee percent. Returned units the warehouse finds opened are not accepted and no receipt is recorded.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical)**

| Delivery date on the proof of delivery | Day the customer asks | 30-day window satisfied? |
|---|---|---|
| day 0 | day 30 | Yes, the last day is allowed |
| day 0 | day 31 | No |
| none recorded | any day | No return; there is no delivery date |

**Unit cases (hypothetical).** A shipment of 6 units with 2 units already authorized for return can have at most 4 more units authorized. A self-pay return of 2 units bought at 18.50 each, with a 15 percent restocking fee, credits 2 times 18.50 less 15 percent, that is 31.45.
